receipts.question: What does I_cohort identify? Confirm the randomization of V06 identifies the total effect on V18 without adjustment; state what additional conditioning (if any) the lane-subgroup contrast (V04) and problem-family subgroups require; flag any backdoor we have missed.

What does I_E2 identify, given the isolation surgery? Verify identification of the availability effect requires severing L1-L4 (i.e., exhibit the backdoor paths each leak edge opens when present); state the mediation decomposition through V13 vs V14 that becomes identifiable once sensor S05 exists, and what remains unidentifiable without it.

Filter-equivalence d-separation: is V18 independent of membership of M in V02, given the realized V12 (surfaced set)? Run on BOTH corpus topologies: star_forest (current) and populated_graph (post multi-attachment repair). Our prediction: holds on star_forest (so E2 mechanism (b) filter-at-dispatch is a valid cheap substitute for (a) ship-different-databases), and FAILS on populated_graph (removing M then changes what else surfaces through shared patterns, so (a) and (b) diverge). A confirmed divergence is itself a finding about the graph-population repair and would be preregistered as such.

What does I_ext identify, given that the natural experiment (E7) chose which module to build based on recorded dependency sets (confounding by need and by problem difficulty)? State the adjustment set for the controlled version, and what the uncontrolled four-closure observation does and does not license.

Withholding validity by provenance regime: exhibit the backdoor paths K1-K4 open when present, and confirm that under full severance, do(withhold M) identifies the availability effect for EXTRACTED modules only. Falsifiable divergence prediction: do(withhold LusinN) has NO effect on a95A02 (independent byte-copies, K2 structurally open, no import edge), while do(withhold BanachZarecki) has a NONZERO effect on a95J06 (extraction-provenance, zero overlap, real import edge). If the engine confirms the asymmetry, duplication debt becomes a measured causal quantity: the difference between removing a module and removing its content.

Sufficiency of the hole-count sensor: is P16-at-round-k+1 independent of P10-at-round-k given T04's reading at round k? Prediction: NO (T04 is not a sufficient statistic for progress; a96A04 is the witness trajectory). And under CJ1, does conditioning on a T05 reading (once built) screen off T04 entirely? A confirmed screening-off is the preregistered case for building T05 and retiring hole-count as a progress meter.
